source.text: וּמִן־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And from the priests: [the] sons of Hobaiah, [the] sons of Hakkoz, [the] sons of Barzillai, who took from [the] daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite a wife and was called by their name.

en.L: And of the priests: [the] sons of Hobaiah, [the] sons of Hakkoz, [the] sons of Barzillai, who took a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name.
en.B: And of the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, the descendants of Hakkoz, the descendants of Barzillai, who had married one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name.
en.R: Some priests had the same problem: the descendants of Hobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai. This Barzillai had married a daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name.

es.L: Y de los sacerdotes: [los] hijos de Hobaía, [los] hijos de Cos, [los] hijos de Barzilai, que tomó mujer de las hijas de Barzilai el galaadita y fue llamado por el nombre de ellas.
es.B: Y de los sacerdotes: los descendientes de Hobaía, los descendientes de Cos, los descendientes de Barzilai, que se había casado con una de las hijas de Barzilai el galaadita y fue llamado por el nombre de ellos.
es.R: Algunos sacerdotes tenían el mismo problema: los descendientes de Hobaía, Cos y Barzilai. Este Barzilai se había casado con una hija de Barzilai, el de Galaad, y había tomado el nombre de la familia de su esposa.

fr.L: Et des prêtres : [les] fils de Hobaya, [les] fils de Haqqots, [les] fils de Barzillaï, qui avait pris une femme parmi les filles de Barzillaï le Galaadite et fut appelé de leur nom.
fr.B: Et parmi les prêtres : les descendants de Hobaya, les descendants de Haqqots, les descendants de Barzillaï, qui avait épousé une des filles de Barzillaï le Galaadite et fut appelé de leur nom.
fr.R: Des prêtres avaient le même problème : les descendants de Hobaya, de Haqqots et de Barzillaï. Ce Barzillaï avait épousé une fille de Barzillaï, de Galaad, et il avait pris le nom de la famille de sa femme.

sw.L: Na katika makuhani: wana wa Hobaya, wana wa Hakosi, wana wa Barzilai, aliyetwaa mke kutoka binti za Barzilai Mgileadi, akaitwa kwa jina lao.
sw.B: Na katika makuhani: wazao wa Hobaya, wazao wa Hakosi, wazao wa Barzilai, aliyekuwa amemwoa mmoja wa binti za Barzilai Mgileadi, akaitwa kwa jina lao.
sw.R: Baadhi ya makuhani walikuwa na tatizo hilo hilo: wazao wa Hobaya, Hakosi na Barzilai. Barzilai huyo alikuwa amemwoa binti wa Barzilai wa Gileadi, akachukua jina la jamaa ya mkewe.

vi.L: Và trong các thầy tế lễ: các con của Hô-ba-gia, các con của Ha-cốt, các con của Bát-xi-lai, là người đã cưới vợ trong các con gái của Bát-xi-lai người Ga-la-át và được gọi theo tên của họ.
vi.B: Trong các thầy tế lễ thì có: con cháu Hô-ba-gia, con cháu Ha-cốt, con cháu Bát-xi-lai, là người đã cưới một con gái của Bát-xi-lai người Ga-la-át và được gọi theo tên của gia đình ấy.
vi.R: Một số thầy tế lễ cũng gặp trường hợp như vậy: con cháu Hô-ba-gia, Ha-cốt và Bát-xi-lai. Ông Bát-xi-lai này đã cưới một con gái của Bát-xi-lai người Ga-la-át và lấy tên gia đình bên vợ.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들 가운데서는 호바야 자손, 학고스 자손, 바르실래 자손이다. [바르실래는] 길르앗 사람 바르실래의 딸들 가운데서 아내를 맞아 그들의 이름으로 불렸다.
ko.B: 제사장들 가운데서는 호바야 자손, 학고스 자손, 바르실래 자손이 그러했다. 이 바르실래는 길르앗 사람 바르실래의 딸들 가운데 하나를 아내로 맞아, 그 집안의 이름으로 불렸다.
ko.R: 제사장들 가운데서도 같은 문제를 가진 사람들이 있었다. 호바야, 학고스, 바르실래의 자손이다. 이 바르실래는 길르앗 사람 바르실래의 딸과 결혼해서 아내 집안의 이름을 따랐다.

pt.L: E dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Hobaías, os filhos de Hacoz, os filhos de Barzilai, que tomou uma mulher das filhas de Barzilai, o gileadita, e foi chamado pelo nome delas.
pt.B: E dos sacerdotes: os descendentes de Hobaías, os descendentes de Hacoz e os descendentes de Barzilai, que tinha se casado com uma das filhas de Barzilai, o gileadita, e passou a ser chamado pelo nome delas.
pt.R: Alguns sacerdotes também não conseguiram provar a sua família: os descendentes de Hobaías, Hacoz e Barzilai. Esse Barzilai tinha se casado com uma filha de Barzilai, de Gileade, e passou a ser chamado pelo nome da família dela.

am.L: ከካህናቱም፦ የሖባያ ልጆች፣ የሀቆጽ ልጆች፣ ከገለዓዳዊው ከቤርዜሊ ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስት ያገባውና በስማቸው የተጠራው የቤርዜሊ ልጆች።
am.B: ከካህናቱም፦ የሖባያ ዘሮች፣ የሀቆጽ ዘሮች፣ ከገለዓዳዊው ከቤርዜሊ ሴቶች ልጆች አንዲቱን አግብቶ በስማቸው የተጠራው የቤርዜሊ ዘሮች።
am.R: አንዳንድ ካህናትም ተመሳሳይ ችግር ነበረባቸው፤ እነርሱም የሖባያ፣ የሀቆጽና የቤርዜሊ ዘሮች ናቸው። ይህ ቤርዜሊ ከገለዓድ የሆነውን የቤርዜሊን ልጅ አግብቶ የሚስቱን ቤተሰብ ስም ወስዶ ነበር።

hi.L: और याजकों में से: होबायाह के पुत्र, हक्कोस के पुत्र, बर्ज़िल्लै के पुत्र, जिसने गिलादी बर्ज़िल्लै की बेटियों में से [एक को] पत्नी करके लिया और उन्हीं के नाम से कहलाया।
hi.B: और याजकों में से: होबायाह के वंशज, हक्कोस के वंशज और बर्ज़िल्लै के वंशज, जिसने गिलादी बर्ज़िल्लै की बेटियों में से एक से विवाह किया था और उन्हीं के नाम से कहलाता था।
hi.R: कुछ याजक भी अपने परिवार साबित न कर सके: होबायाह, हक्कोस और बर्ज़िल्लै के वंशज। इस बर्ज़िल्लै ने गिलाद के बर्ज़िल्लै की एक बेटी से विवाह किया था, और वह अपनी पत्नी के परिवार के नाम से कहलाता था।

ru.L: И из священников: сыновья Ховаии, сыновья Гаккоца, сыновья Верзеллия, который взял жену из дочерей Верзеллия галаадитянина и был назван их именем.
ru.B: И из священников: потомки Ховаии, потомки Гаккоца и потомки Верзеллия, который женился на одной из дочерей Верзеллия галаадитянина и стал называться их именем.
ru.R: Некоторые священники тоже не смогли доказать, из какой они семьи: потомки Ховаии, Гаккоца и Верзеллия. Этот Верзеллий женился на дочери Верзеллия из Галаада и стал называться по имени её семьи.

ja.L: また祭司たちのうちから、ホバヤの子ら、ハコツの子ら、バルジライの子ら。[このバルジライは]ギレアド人バルジライの娘たちの中から妻をめとり、彼らの名で呼ばれた[者である]。
ja.B: 祭司の中からは、ホバヤの子孫、ハコツの子孫、バルジライの子孫。このバルジライは、ギレアド人バルジライの娘の一人と結婚し、その一族の名で呼ばれるようになった者である。
ja.R: 祭司の中にも、自分の家系を証明できない人々がいました。ホバヤ、ハコツ、バルジライの子孫です。このバルジライは、ギレアド出身のバルジライの娘と結婚して、妻の一族の名で呼ばれるようになった人です。

uk.L: І зі священників: сини Ховаї, сини Гаккоца, сини Барзіллая, який узяв жінку з дочок Барзіллая гілеадця і був названий їхнім імʼям.
uk.B: І зі священників: нащадки Ховаї, нащадки Гаккоца, нащадки Барзіллая, який одружився з однією з дочок Барзіллая гілеадця і був названий їхнім імʼям.
uk.R: Те саме сталося і з деякими священниками: з нащадками Ховаї, Гаккоца і Барзіллая. Цей Барзіллай одружився з дочкою Барзіллая з Гілеаду і взяв імʼя родини своєї жінки.

decisions.choice: Barzillai the Gileadite: the old man who supplied David east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Barzillai of Gilead brought food to David when he fled from Absalom, and David honored his family (2 Samuel 17:27-29; 19:32-40; 1 Kings 2:7).

decisions.choice: was called by their name: took the family name of his wife's family
decisions.reason: The priest who married into Barzillai's family took its name, perhaps to share its standing or inheritance. His descendants were then known as "sons of Barzillai", and their priestly descent could no longer be shown (verse 64). Ezra 2:61 spells the first name Habaiah.

decisions.choice: Some priests had the same problem (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the link with verse 61: these priests, too, could not prove their line.

decisions.choice: E dos sacerdotes (L)
decisions.reason: Ezra 2:61 reads "of the sons of the priests"; Nehemiah's Hebrew says "from the priests", so Literal drops "filhos" here. The rest of the verse keeps the Portuguese of Ezra 2:61 at each level, "Barzilai, o gileadita" as 2 Samuel 17:27 (m1).

decisions.choice: "ከካህናቱም" (and of the priests); Ezra 2:61 has "ከካህናቱ ልጆችም" (of the sons of the priests)
decisions.reason: Nehemiah's Hebrew lacks "the sons of" here.

decisions.choice: "और याजकों में से" (L)
decisions.reason: Nehemiah says "and from the priests" where Ezra 2:61 says "and of the sons of the priests" (और याजकों के पुत्रों में से), so Literal drops के पुत्रों; Balanced and Readable already had Ezra's shorter wording.

decisions.choice: "И из священников" (L)
decisions.reason: Ezra 2:61 says "of the sons of the priests"; Nehemiah's Hebrew says "from the priests", which Literal follows. Balanced and Readable already read as Ezra's do.

source.text: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַיְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: These sought their writing, the ones enrolled by genealogy, and not it was found; and they were defiled from the priesthood.

en.L: These sought their record [among] those enrolled by genealogy, but it was not found; and they were defiled [and removed] from the priesthood.
en.B: These searched for their record among those enrolled by genealogy, but it could not be found, so they were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
en.R: They looked for their names in the family records, but they could not find them. So they were not allowed to serve as priests.

es.L: Estos buscaron su registro [entre] los inscritos por genealogía, pero no se halló, y fueron tenidos por impuros [y excluidos] del sacerdocio.
es.B: Estos buscaron su inscripción en los registros de familias, pero no la encontraron, así que fueron excluidos del sacerdocio como impuros.
es.R: Buscaron sus nombres en los registros de familias, pero no los encontraron. Por eso no se les permitió servir como sacerdotes.

fr.L: Ceux-ci cherchèrent leur registre [parmi] ceux qui étaient inscrits par généalogie, mais il ne fut pas trouvé, et ils furent déclarés impurs [et exclus] du sacerdoce.
fr.B: Ils cherchèrent leur inscription dans les registres généalogiques, mais on ne l’y trouva pas ; ils furent donc écartés du sacerdoce comme impurs.
fr.R: Ils ont cherché leurs noms dans les registres des familles, mais ils ne les ont pas trouvés. Alors on ne les a pas laissés servir comme prêtres.

sw.L: Hawa walitafuta maandiko yao [kati ya] walioandikwa kwa nasaba, lakini hayakuonekana, wakahesabiwa kuwa najisi [na kuondolewa] katika ukuhani.
sw.B: Hawa walitafuta majina yao kati ya walioandikwa katika orodha za ukoo, lakini hayakupatikana humo, kwa hiyo wakazuiwa kuwa makuhani kwa kuwa walihesabiwa kuwa najisi.
sw.R: Walitafuta majina yao katika kumbukumbu za jamaa, lakini hawakuyapata. Kwa hiyo hawakuruhusiwa kutumika kama makuhani.

vi.L: Những người này tìm sổ ghi của mình [trong số] những người được ghi vào gia phả, nhưng không tìm thấy, và họ bị coi là ô uế [và bị loại] khỏi chức tế lễ.
vi.B: Những người này tìm tên mình trong sổ gia phả nhưng không thấy, nên họ bị coi là ô uế và bị loại khỏi chức tế lễ.
vi.R: Họ tìm tên mình trong sổ ghi chép các gia đình, nhưng không tìm thấy. Vì vậy họ không được phục vụ làm thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 이 사람들이 족보에 오른 자들 가운데서 자기들의 기록을 찾았으나 찾지 못했다. 그래서 그들은 부정한 자로 여겨져 제사장 직분에서 [제외되었다].
ko.B: 이 사람들은 족보 기록에서 자기 이름을 찾았지만 찾지 못했다. 그래서 그들은 부정하다고 여겨져 제사장 직분에서 제외되었다.
ko.R: 그들은 집안 기록에서 자기 이름을 찾아보았지만 찾지 못했다. 그래서 그들은 제사장 일을 할 수 없었다.

pt.L: Estes procuraram o seu registro [entre] os inscritos na genealogia, mas não foi encontrado, e foram tratados como impuros [e excluídos] do sacerdócio.
pt.B: Estes procuraram o seu registro entre os que estavam inscritos nos registros de família, mas ele não foi encontrado, e por isso foram afastados do sacerdócio como impuros.
pt.R: Eles procuraram os seus nomes nos registros das famílias, mas os nomes não estavam lá. Por isso não puderam servir como sacerdotes.

am.L: እነዚህ በትውልድ ከተመዘገቡት መካከል መዝገባቸውን ፈለጉ፤ ነገር ግን አልተገኘም፤ ስለዚህ እንደ ረከሱ ተቆጥረው ከክህነት [ተለዩ]።
am.B: እነዚህ በቤተሰብ መዝገብ ከተጻፉት መካከል ስማቸውን ፈለጉ፤ ነገር ግን በዚያ አልተገኘም፤ ስለዚህ ርኩሳን ተብለው ከክህነት ተከለከሉ።
am.R: ስማቸውን በቤተሰብ መዝገቦች ውስጥ ፈለጉ፤ ነገር ግን ሊያገኙት አልቻሉም። ስለዚህ ካህናት ሆነው እንዲያገለግሉ አልተፈቀደላቸውም።

hi.L: इन्होंने वंशावली में लिखे हुओं [के बीच] अपना लेख ढूँढ़ा, पर वह न मिला, और वे अशुद्ध ठहराकर याजकपद से [अलग किए गए]।
hi.B: इन्होंने वंशावली के अभिलेखों में अपना लेख ढूँढ़ा, पर वह वहाँ न मिला, इसलिए वे अशुद्ध ठहराए गए और याजकपद से अलग कर दिए गए।
hi.R: उन्होंने परिवारों की सूचियों में अपने नाम ढूँढ़े, पर उनके नाम वहाँ नहीं थे। इसलिए उन्हें याजक का काम करने नहीं दिया गया, क्योंकि वे अशुद्ध माने गए।

ru.L: Эти искали своей записи [среди] внесённых в родословия, но она не нашлась, и были признаны нечистыми [и отстранены] от священства.
ru.B: Они искали свои записи в родословных списках, но не нашли их там, и поэтому их отстранили от священства как нечистых.
ru.R: Они искали свои имена в родословных списках, но имён там не было. Поэтому им не позволили служить священниками: их сочли нечистыми.

ja.L: これらの者は、系図に記載された者たちの中に自分たちの記録を捜したが、見つからなかった。それで彼らは汚れた者とされ、祭司職から[除かれた]。
ja.B: 彼らは系図に記載された者たちの中に自分たちの記録を捜したが、見つからなかったので、汚れた者として祭司職から除かれた。
ja.R: 彼らは家系の記録の中に自分の名前を探しましたが、見つかりませんでした。それで、汚れた者とされ、祭司として仕えることを許されませんでした。

uk.L: Ці шукали свого запису [серед] записаних у родоводи, але не знайшли, і їх визнали оскверненими [і відсторонили] від священства.
uk.B: Вони шукали свого запису серед записаних у родоводах, але його не знайшли, тож їх відсторонили від священства як нечистих.
uk.R: Вони шукали своїх імен у родинних записах, але не знайшли їх. Тому їм не дозволили служити священниками.

decisions.choice: their writing, the ones enrolled: their entry in the genealogical register
decisions.reason: "Their writing" is their written record; the next words, "those enrolled by genealogy", name the register where it should have stood.

decisions.choice: defiled from the priesthood: treated as unclean and so barred from serving as priests
decisions.reason: The verb means "to be defiled". With "from" it says that they were counted unfit and shut out of the priesthood. They were not shown to be outsiders; their claim simply could not be proved, and the matter was left open (verse 65).

decisions.choice: "አልተገኘም" (it was not found), singular, as Nehemiah's Hebrew; Ezra 2:62 has "they were not found" ("አልተገኙም")
decisions.reason: The record, not the men, was not found.

decisions.choice: "अपना लेख ... वह वहाँ न मिला" (B)
decisions.reason: Where Ezra 2:62 says "they were not found", Nehemiah's Hebrew says "it was not found", their written record, so Balanced has the singular लेख, as the English does, in place of Ezra's "अपने नाम ... वे वहाँ न मिले".

decisions.choice: "но она не нашлась" (L)
decisions.reason: Ezra 2:62 has the plural "they were not found"; Nehemiah's Hebrew has the singular, "it was not found", the record. Balanced and Readable keep Ezra's wording, which already says that the records were not found.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וְתוּמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the Tirshatha to them that not they shall eat from [the] holy of the holy things until stands a priest for Urim and Thummim.

en.L: And the Tirshatha said to them that they should not eat from the most holy things until a priest stood up for Urim and Thummim.
en.B: The governor told them that they were not to eat any of the most holy food until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
en.R: The governor told them not to eat any of the most holy food given to the priests. They had to wait until there was a priest who could ask God about it with the Urim and Thummim.

es.L: Y el Tirsata les dijo que no comieran de las cosas santísimas hasta que se levantara un sacerdote para [consultar] el urim y el tumim.
es.B: El gobernador les dijo que no comieran de los alimentos santísimos hasta que hubiera un sacerdote que consultara el urim y el tumim.
es.R: El gobernador les dijo que no podían comer de los alimentos santísimos que les tocaban a los sacerdotes. Tenían que esperar hasta que hubiera un sacerdote que pudiera conocer la respuesta de Dios usando el urim y el tumim.

fr.L: Et le Tirshatha leur dit qu’ils ne mangeraient pas des choses très saintes jusqu’à ce qu’un prêtre se lève pour les ourim et les toummim.
fr.B: Le gouverneur leur dit de ne manger d’aucun des aliments très saints jusqu’à ce qu’il y ait un prêtre pour consulter les ourim et les toummim.
fr.R: Le gouverneur leur a dit qu’ils ne devaient pas manger la nourriture très sainte réservée aux prêtres. Ils devaient attendre qu’il y ait un prêtre capable de connaître la réponse de Dieu au moyen des ourim et des toummim.

sw.L: Naye Tirshatha akawaambia kwamba wasile katika vitu vitakatifu kuliko vyote mpaka kuhani asimame kwa ajili ya Urimu na Thumimu.
sw.B: Liwali akawaambia wasile chakula chochote kilicho kitakatifu kuliko vyote mpaka atakapokuwepo kuhani wa kuuliza kwa Urimu na Thumimu.
sw.R: Liwali aliwaambia wasile chakula kitakatifu sana kilichokuwa cha makuhani. Walipaswa kungoja mpaka atakapokuwepo kuhani ambaye angeweza kupata jibu la Mungu kwa kutumia Urimu na Thumimu.

vi.L: Và quan Tiệt-sa-tha bảo họ rằng họ không được ăn các vật chí thánh cho đến khi có một thầy tế lễ đứng lên [dùng] U-rim và Thu-mim.
vi.B: Quan tổng đốc bảo họ không được ăn các thức ăn chí thánh cho đến khi có một thầy tế lễ cầu hỏi bằng U-rim và Thu-mim.
vi.R: Quan tổng đốc bảo họ không được ăn thức ăn rất thánh dành cho các thầy tế lễ. Họ phải chờ đến khi có một thầy tế lễ có thể dùng U-rim và Thu-mim để biết câu trả lời của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 디르사다가 그들에게, 우림과 둠밈을 위하여 제사장이 일어설 때까지 지극히 거룩한 것을 먹지 말라고 말했다.
ko.B: 총독은 그들에게, 우림과 둠밈으로 물을 제사장이 나설 때까지 가장 거룩한 음식은 먹지 말라고 했다.
ko.R: 총독은 그들에게 제사장들의 몫인 가장 거룩한 음식을 먹어서는 안 된다고 말했다. 우림과 둠밈을 써서 하나님의 대답을 알아낼 수 있는 제사장이 생길 때까지 기다려야 했다.

pt.L: E o Tirsata lhes disse que não comessem das coisas santíssimas até que se levantasse um sacerdote para o Urim e o Tumim.
pt.B: O governador lhes disse que não comessem nada das ofertas santíssimas até que houvesse um sacerdote para consultar o Urim e o Tumim.
pt.R: O governador disse a eles que não podiam comer a comida santíssima que pertencia aos sacerdotes. Tinham de esperar até que houvesse um sacerdote que pudesse descobrir a resposta de Deus usando o Urim e o Tumim.

am.L: ቲርሻታውም ለኡሪምና ለቱሚም ካህን እስኪነሣ ድረስ እጅግ ቅዱስ ከሆኑት ነገሮች እንዳይበሉ ነገራቸው።
am.B: አገረ ገዥውም ኡሪምንና ቱሚምን የሚጠይቅ ካህን እስኪገኝ ድረስ እጅግ ቅዱስ ከሆነው ምግብ እንዳይበሉ ነገራቸው።
am.R: አገረ ገዥውም ለካህናቱ ከተሰጠው እጅግ ቅዱስ ምግብ ምንም እንዳይበሉ ነገራቸው። በኡሪምና በቱሚም እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ጉዳዩ መጠየቅ የሚችል ካህን እስኪገኝ ድረስ መጠበቅ ነበረባቸው።

hi.L: और तिर्शाता ने उनसे कहा कि जब तक ऊरीम और तुम्मीम के लिए कोई याजक खड़ा न हो, तब तक वे परमपवित्र वस्तुओं में से न खाएँ।
hi.B: राज्यपाल ने उनसे कहा कि जब तक ऊरीम और तुम्मीम से पूछनेवाला कोई याजक न हो, तब तक वे परमपवित्र भोजन में से कुछ न खाएँ।
hi.R: राज्यपाल ने उनसे कहा कि वे याजकों का वह परमपवित्र भोजन न खाएँ। उन्हें तब तक रुकना था जब तक कोई ऐसा याजक न हो जो ऊरीम और तुम्मीम के द्वारा परमेश्वर का उत्तर जान सके।

ru.L: И сказал им Тиршафа, чтобы они не ели от святыни святынь, пока не встанет священник для урима и туммима.
ru.B: Правитель велел им не есть ничего из великих святынь, пока не появится священник, который вопросит Бога через урим и туммим.
ru.R: Правитель сказал им, что им нельзя есть самую святую пищу, которая принадлежит священникам. Им нужно ждать, пока не будет священника, который сможет узнать ответ Бога с помощью урима и туммима.

ja.L: そしてティルシャタは彼らに、ウリムとトンミムのための祭司が立つまでは、聖なるものの中の聖なるものから食べてはならない、と言った。
ja.B: 総督は彼らに、ウリムとトンミムによって伺いを立てる祭司が現れるまでは、最も聖なるものを食べてはならないと命じた。
ja.R: 総督は彼らに、祭司のための最も聖なる食べ物を食べてはいけない、と言いました。ウリムとトンミムを使って神の答えを知ることのできる祭司が現れるまで、待たなければならなかったのです。

uk.L: І сказав їм Тіршата, щоб вони не їли з найсвятішого, доки не стане священник з урімом і туммімом.
uk.B: Намісник наказав їм не їсти найсвятішої їжі, доки не зʼявиться священник, який запитає волю Бога через урім і туммім.
uk.R: Намісник сказав їм не їсти найсвятішої їжі, яку давали священникам. Вони мали чекати, доки зʼявиться священник, який зможе запитати про це Бога за допомогою уріма і тумміма.

decisions.choice: the Tirshatha: a Persian title for the governor
decisions.reason: The word is a Persian title, perhaps meaning "his excellency". Nehemiah bears it in 8:9 and 10:2, but this sentence belongs to the register of the first return, so the governor here is probably the leader of that time, such as Zerubbabel (Haggai 1:1), as in Ezra 2:63.

decisions.choice: the most holy things: the portions of the offerings set apart for priests
decisions.reason: "Holy of holies" here means the most holy parts of the offerings, which only priests and their sons could eat (Leviticus 2:3; 6:17-18; Numbers 18:9-10). Eating them would have treated these men as proven priests.

decisions.choice: a priest for Urim and Thummim: a priest able to seek God's answer by the sacred lots
decisions.reason: The Urim and Thummim were kept in the high priest's breastpiece and used to receive God's decision (Exodus 28:30; Numbers 27:21; 1 Samuel 28:6). There is no record of their use after the exile, so the case stayed undecided.

decisions.choice: the Tirshatha (Literal); the governor (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Persian title; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: who could ask God about it with (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the Urim and Thummim were for, so that the reason for waiting is clear.

decisions.choice: "el Tirsata" (L); "el gobernador" (B, R); "el urim y el tumim"
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 2:63, the same sentence: Literal keeps the Persian title as a name, Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: « le Tirshatha » (L); « le gouverneur » (B, R); « les ourim et les toummim »
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 2:63, the same sentence: Literal keeps the Persian title, Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "Tirshatha" (L), "liwali" (B, R); "Urimu na Thumimu"
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 2:63, the same sentence.

decisions.choice: quan Tiệt-sa-tha (L); quan tổng đốc (B, R); U-rim và Thu-mim
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 2:63, the same sentence.

decisions.choice: "디르사다" (L), "총독" (B, R); "우림과 둠밈"
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 2:63, the same sentence.

decisions.choice: o Tirsata (L); o governador (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Ezra 2:63 in Portuguese, whose words this verse repeats at each level: Literal keeps the Persian title as a name, as the English Literal does (m1), and Balanced and Readable say what it means. The same holds in 7:69 and 8:9.

decisions.choice: "ቲርሻታው" (Literal) / "አገረ ገዥው" (Balanced, Readable) for the Tirshatha, and the rest of the verse, as Ezra 2:63
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as Ezra 2:63 but for small spellings.

decisions.choice: "तिर्शाता" (Literal); "राज्यपाल" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 2:63 and Nehemiah 8:9: Literal keeps the Persian title as a name, Balanced and Readable say governor.

decisions.choice: "Тиршафа" (L); "правитель" (B, R), as Ezra 2:63
decisions.reason: The list keeps Ezra 2:63's wording for the title, and Nehemiah 8:9 and 10:2 use it too where it is joined to Nehemiah's name; "наместник" is kept for the ordinary word for governor (pechah).

decisions.choice: hattirshata' "ティルシャタ" (L), "総督" (B, R), as Ezra 2:63.
decisions.reason: As the English: the Persian title at L, its sense at B and R.

decisions.choice: 42,360: more than the sum of the groups listed
decisions.reason: The groups listed in verses 8-62 add up to 31,089. Ezra 2:64 gives the same total, 42,360, although its own items add up to a different sum. The text does not say who makes up the difference; the total may include people not listed by family. The total is translated as it stands.

decisions.choice: the assembly: the whole community of returnees
decisions.reason: The word is used of Israel gathered as one people (Deuteronomy 31:30; Ezra 10:1). Here it names everyone who returned, counted together.

source.text: מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ וּמְשֹׁ֣רֲר֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס

sw.R: Zaidi ya hao, kulikuwa na watumwa wa kiume na wa kike 7,337, na waimbaji 245, wanaume na wanawake.

vi.L: ngoài các tôi trai và các tớ gái của họ; những người này [là] 7.337; và họ có người nam và người nữ ca hát, 245.
vi.B: không kể các tôi trai tớ gái của họ là 7.337 người; họ cũng có 245 nam nữ ca sĩ.
vi.R: Ngoài số ấy, còn có 7.337 tôi trai tớ gái, và 245 người nam và người nữ làm ca sĩ.

ko.L: 그들의 남종들과 여종들 외에[였다]. 이들은 7,337명이었다. 그리고 그들에게는 노래하는 남자들과 노래하는 여자들 245명이 있었다.
ko.B: 그 밖에 그들의 남종과 여종이 7,337명이었고, 노래하는 남녀가 245명 있었다.
ko.R: 이 밖에도 남종과 여종이 7,337명이었고, 노래하는 남자와 여자가 245명 있었다.

pt.L: além dos seus escravos e das suas escravas; estes [eram] 7.337; e eles tinham cantores e cantoras: 245.
pt.B: sem contar os seus escravos e as suas escravas, que eram 7.337. Tinham também 245 cantores e cantoras.
pt.R: Isso não incluía os seus 7.337 escravos e escravas. Eles também tinham 245 homens e mulheres que eram cantores.

am.L: [ይህም] ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ባሪያዎቻቸው ሌላ [ነው]፤ እነዚህም 7,337 [ነበሩ]፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ዘፋኞችም ነበሯቸው፤ 245።
am.B: ይህም ቁጥራቸው 7,337 የሆነውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቻቸውን ሳይጨምር ነው። ደግሞም 245 ወንዶችና ሴቶች ዘፋኞች ነበሯቸው።
am.R: ይህ ቁጥር 7,337 ወንድና ሴት ባሪያዎቻቸውን አይጨምርም። ደግሞም ዘፋኞች የሆኑ 245 ወንዶችና ሴቶች ነበሯቸው።

hi.L: उनके दासों और उनकी दासियों के अलावा; ये 7,337 [थे]; और उनके 245 गायक और गायिकाएँ थीं।
hi.B: उनके दास-दासियों को छोड़कर, जिनकी गिनती 7,337 थी; और उनके पास 245 गायक और गायिकाएँ थीं।
hi.R: इनके अलावा 7,337 दास और दासियाँ थीं, और 245 पुरुष और स्त्रियाँ थीं जो गायक थे।

ru.L: кроме их рабов и их рабынь; этих [было] 7337; и [были] у них 245 певцов и певиц.
ru.B: не считая их рабов и рабынь, которых было 7337; и было у них 245 певцов и певиц.
ru.R: Кроме них, было 7337 рабов и рабынь и 245 мужчин и женщин, которые были певцами.

ja.L: そのほかに、彼らの男奴隷と女奴隷がおり、これらは七千三百三十七[人]であった。また彼らには男女の歌い手が二百四十五[人]いた。
ja.B: そのほかに、男女の召し使いが七千三百三十七人いた。また、男女の歌い手が二百四十五人いた。
ja.R: そのほかに、男女の召し使いが七千三百三十七人、歌を歌う男女が二百四十五人いました。

uk.L: крім їхніх рабів і їхніх рабинь; цих [було] 7337; і [були] в них співаки і співачки — 245.
uk.B: не рахуючи їхніх слуг і служниць, яких було 7337. Були в них також 245 співаків і співачок.
uk.R: До цього числа не входили 7337 їхніх слуг і служниць. Були в них також 245 співаків і співачок.

decisions.choice: male and female slaves: people owned by the returning families
decisions.reason: These were servants owned by the families, not hired workers. They are counted apart from the assembly of Israel, as the animals are counted after them (verse 68).

decisions.choice: male and female singers: singers kept by the families, not the temple singers
decisions.reason: These are not the temple singers of verse 44, who were all men of Asaph's line. Singers, men and women, sang at feasts and at mourning (2 Samuel 19:35; 2 Chronicles 35:25). Ezra 2:65 gives 200.

decisions.choice: slaves at every level
decisions.reason: Here the point is the difference between free members of the assembly and people owned by them, so "slaves" is kept at Balanced and Readable too, as the style guide does where slave is set against free.

decisions.choice: "esclavos y esclavas" at every level, as the English of Nehemiah
alternatives: "siervos y siervas" at Balanced and Readable, as Ezra 2:65
decisions.reason: The English of Nehemiah says "slaves" at every level here, where the Spanish of Ezra 2:65 has "siervos" at Balanced and Readable; the people counted are owned servants, so Nehemiah follows its own English. The rest of the verse keeps the wording of Ezra 2:65.

decisions.choice: « esclaves, hommes et femmes » at every level, as the English of Nehemiah
alternatives: « serviteurs et servantes » at Balanced and Readable, as Ezra 2:65
decisions.reason: The English of Nehemiah says "slaves" at every level here, where the French of Ezra 2:65 has « serviteurs » at Balanced and Readable; the people counted are owned servants, so Nehemiah follows its own English. The rest of the verse keeps the wording of Ezra 2:65.

decisions.choice: "watumwa" at every level, as the English of Nehemiah
alternatives: "watumishi" at Balanced and Readable, as Ezra 2:65
decisions.reason: The English of Nehemiah says "slaves" at every level here, where the Swahili of Ezra 2:65 has "watumishi" at Balanced and Readable; the people counted are owned servants, so Nehemiah follows its own English. The rest of the verse keeps the wording of Ezra 2:65.

decisions.choice: escravos e escravas (every level)
alternatives: servos e servas (B, R), as Ezra 2:65 in Portuguese
decisions.reason: The English keeps "slaves" at every level here (r-en-1), because the verse sets the free members of the assembly against the people they owned (m1), and the Old Testament terms keep "escravo" at every level where slavery itself is the point. Ezra 2:65 says "servos e servas" at Balanced and Readable; Nehemiah follows its own English decision.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያዎች" (slaves) at every level, and "245" singers as Nehemiah's Hebrew; Ezra 2:65 has 200 singers and "አገልጋዮች" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: People owned by the families are slaves, as the English says at every level here; "ዘፋኞች" for the household singers, as Ezra 2:65, apart from the temple "መዘምራን".

decisions.choice: 'avdeihem ve'amhoteihem "男奴隷と女奴隷" (L), "男女の召し使い" (B, R), as Ezra 2:65.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is Ezra 2:65 word for word (only the number of singers differs), so the Japanese is the same; household slaves are "召し使い" at B and R, as Genesis and Deuteronomy, although the English here says slaves.

source.text: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑הסחֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Camels, four hundred thirty and five; donkeys, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

en.L: Camels, 435; donkeys, 6,720.
en.B: There were 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.
en.R: They had 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.

es.L: Camellos, 435; asnos, 6 720.
es.B: Había 435 camellos y 6 720 asnos.
es.R: Tenían 435 camellos y 6 720 burros.

fr.L: Chameaux, 435 ; ânes, 6 720.
fr.B: Il y avait 435 chameaux et 6 720 ânes.
fr.R: Ils avaient 435 chameaux et 6 720 ânes.

sw.L: Ngamia, 435; punda, 6,720.
sw.B: Kulikuwa na ngamia 435 na punda 6,720.
sw.R: Walikuwa na ngamia 435 na punda 6,720.

vi.L: Lạc đà, 435; lừa, 6.720.
vi.B: Có 435 con lạc đà và 6.720 con lừa.
vi.R: Họ có 435 con lạc đà và 6.720 con lừa.

pt.L: Camelos: 435; jumentos: 6.720.
pt.B: Havia 435 camelos e 6.720 jumentos.
pt.R: Eles tinham 435 camelos e 6.720 jumentos.

hi.R: उनके पास 435 ऊँट और 6,720 गधे थे।

ru.L: Верблюдов 435, ослов 6720.
ru.B: Было 435 верблюдов и 6720 ослов.
ru.R: У них было 435 верблюдов и 6720 ослов.

ja.L: らくだ、四百三十五[頭]。ろば、六千七百二十[頭]。
ja.B: らくだが四百三十五頭、ろばが六千七百二十頭いた。
ja.R: 彼らには、らくだが四百三十五頭、ろばが六千七百二十頭いました。

uk.L: Верблюдів — 435, ослів — 6720.
uk.B: Було 435 верблюдів і 6720 ослів.
uk.R: У них було 435 верблюдів і 6720 ослів.

decisions.choice: no horses and mules: the Hebrew text has no line about them here
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text followed here (the Leningrad Codex) goes straight from the singers to the camels. Ezra 2:66 has "their horses, 736; their mules, 245" before the camels, and some Hebrew manuscripts have that line here too. A copyist's eye may have jumped from the 245 singers to the 245 mules and left out the line between. This translation follows its Hebrew text and does not add the line.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: Hebrew 7:68-72 is 7:69-73 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: Many Bibles add the line about horses and mules from Ezra 2:66 as their verse 68, so from here to the end of the chapter their numbers are one higher than the Hebrew: Hebrew 7:68-72 is their 7:69-73. This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does.

decisions.choice: There were ... (Balanced); They had ... (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is a bare list of animals and numbers; Balanced and Readable make it a sentence.

decisions.choice: No horses and mules: the line of Ezra 2:66 is not in Nehemiah's Hebrew; camels and donkeys as Ezra 2:67, without "their" at Literal
decisions.reason: The Amharic follows the Hebrew of Nehemiah, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "ऊँट, 435; गधे, 6,720" (L), with no horses or mules
decisions.reason: Ezra 2:66-67 lists their horses and mules and says "their camels"; the Hebrew of Nehemiah has no line for horses and mules and no "their", so Literal is a bare list and Balanced and Readable make it a sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: a sentence of its own: "Верблюдов 435" (L), "Было" (B), "У них было" (R)
alternatives: Ezra 2:67's "их верблюдов 435" continuing the horses and mules
decisions.reason: Ezra 2:66 counts horses and mules before the camels and 2:67 goes on "их верблюдов"; Nehemiah's Hebrew has no line for horses and mules and says "camels" without "their", so the verse stands alone and Balanced and Readable supply the verb, as the English does.

decisions.choice: No horses and mules here, as the Hebrew (Ezra 2:66 has them); the Hebrew verse numbers 7:68-72 are kept.
decisions.reason: The English footnote gives 7:69-73 for other Bibles.

source.text: וּמִקְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת נָתְנ֖וּ לַמְּלָאכָ֑ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָאוֹצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ מִזְרָק֣וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים כָּתְנוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And from [the] end of [the] heads of the fathers [some] gave for the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasury: gold, darics, a thousand; bowls, fifty; tunics of priests, thirty and five hundred.

en.L: And some of the heads of the fathers gave for the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasury: gold, 1,000 darics; fifty bowls; 530 priests' tunics.
en.B: Some of the heads of families gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 gold darics, fifty bowls and 530 garments for priests.
en.R: Some of the family leaders gave gifts for the work. The governor gave the treasury 1,000 gold coins called darics, fifty bowls and 530 robes for the priests.

es.L: Y algunos de los jefes de las [casas] paternas dieron para la obra. El Tirsata dio al tesoro: oro, 1 000 dáricos; cincuenta tazones; 530 túnicas de sacerdotes.
es.B: Algunos de los jefes de familia dieron para la obra. El gobernador dio al tesoro 1 000 dáricos de oro, cincuenta tazones y 530 vestiduras para los sacerdotes.
es.R: Algunos de los jefes de familia dieron ofrendas para la obra. El gobernador dio al tesoro 1 000 monedas de oro llamadas dáricos, cincuenta tazones y 530 túnicas para los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et certains des chefs des pères donnèrent pour l’ouvrage. Le Tirshatha donna au trésor : en or, 1 000 dariques ; cinquante bassins ; 530 tuniques de prêtres.
fr.B: Quelques-uns des chefs des familles donnèrent pour l’ouvrage. Le gouverneur donna au trésor 1 000 dariques d’or, cinquante bassins et 530 vêtements pour les prêtres.
fr.R: Certains chefs de famille ont fait des dons pour les travaux. Le gouverneur a donné au trésor 1 000 pièces d’or appelées dariques, cinquante bassins et 530 tuniques pour les prêtres.

sw.L: Na baadhi ya wakuu wa baba walitoa kwa ajili ya kazi. Tirshatha alitoa kwa hazina: dhahabu, darkoni 1,000; mabakuli hamsini; kanzu za makuhani 530.
sw.B: Baadhi ya wakuu wa jamaa walitoa kwa ajili ya kazi. Liwali alitoa kwa hazina darkoni 1,000 za dhahabu, mabakuli hamsini na mavazi 530 ya makuhani.
sw.R: Baadhi ya viongozi wa jamaa walitoa zawadi kwa ajili ya kazi. Liwali aliipa hazina sarafu 1,000 za dhahabu ziitwazo darkoni, mabakuli hamsini na kanzu 530 za makuhani.

vi.L: Và một số người đứng đầu các gia tộc đã dâng cho công việc. Quan Tiệt-sa-tha dâng vào kho: vàng, 1.000 đa-riếc; năm mươi cái chậu; 530 áo dài của thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Một số trưởng tộc đã dâng cho công việc. Quan tổng đốc dâng vào kho 1.000 đa-riếc vàng, năm mươi cái chậu và 530 bộ áo cho các thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Một số người đứng đầu các gia đình đã dâng quà cho công việc. Quan tổng đốc dâng vào kho 1.000 đồng tiền vàng gọi là đa-riếc, năm mươi cái chậu và 530 bộ áo cho các thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 그리고 조상들의 우두머리들 가운데 몇 사람이 공사를 위해 드렸다. 디르사다는 금고에 금 1,000다릭과 대접 50개와 제사장의 옷 530벌을 드렸다.
ko.B: 집안 우두머리들 가운데 몇 사람이 공사를 위해 바쳤다. 총독은 금고에 금 1,000다릭과 대접 50개와 제사장의 옷 530벌을 바쳤다.
ko.R: 집안 지도자들 가운데 몇 사람이 공사를 위해 예물을 바쳤다. 총독은 다릭이라는 금화 1,000개와 대접 50개와 제사장들이 입을 옷 530벌을 금고에 바쳤다.

pt.L: E alguns dos chefes dos pais deram para a obra. O Tirsata deu ao tesouro: ouro, mil dáricos; cinquenta bacias; quinhentas e trinta túnicas de sacerdotes.
pt.B: Alguns dos chefes das famílias deram contribuições para a obra. O governador deu ao tesouro mil dáricos de ouro, cinquenta bacias e quinhentas e trinta túnicas para os sacerdotes.
pt.R: Alguns dos chefes das famílias deram presentes para a obra. O governador deu ao tesouro mil moedas de ouro chamadas dáricos, cinquenta bacias e quinhentas e trinta túnicas para os sacerdotes.

am.L: ከአባቶች [ቤቶች] አለቆችም አንዳንዶቹ ለሥራው ሰጡ። ቲርሻታው ለግምጃ ቤቱ ሰጠ፤ ወርቅ 1,000 ዳሪክ፣ ሃምሳ መርጫ ሳሕኖች፣ የካህናት ቀሚሶች 530።
am.B: ከቤተሰብ አለቆችም አንዳንዶቹ ለሥራው ሰጡ። አገረ ገዥው ለግምጃ ቤቱ 1,000 የወርቅ ዳሪክ፣ ሃምሳ መርጫ ሳሕኖችና ለካህናት 530 ልብሶች ሰጠ።
am.R: ከቤተሰብ መሪዎቹ አንዳንዶቹ ለሥራው ስጦታ ሰጡ። አገረ ገዥው ለግምጃ ቤቱ ዳሪክ የሚባሉ 1,000 የወርቅ ሳንቲሞች፣ ሃምሳ ሳሕኖችና ለካህናቱ 530 ልብሶች ሰጠ።

hi.L: और पितृकुलों के प्रधानों में से कुछ ने काम के लिए दिया। तिर्शाता ने भंडार में दिया: सोना, 1,000 दारिक; पचास कटोरे; याजकों के 530 कुरते।
hi.B: परिवारों के कुछ प्रधानों ने काम के लिए दिया। राज्यपाल ने भंडार में 1,000 सोने के दारिक, पचास कटोरे और याजकों के लिए 530 वस्त्र दिए।
hi.R: परिवारों के कुछ मुखियों ने काम के लिए भेंटें दीं। राज्यपाल ने भंडार में 1,000 सोने के सिक्के दिए जो दारिक कहलाते थे, और पचास कटोरे, और याजकों के लिए कपड़ों के 530 जोड़े।

ru.L: И некоторые из глав отцовских домов дали на работу. Тиршафа дал в сокровищницу: золота — 1000 дариков; пятьдесят чаш; 530 священнических хитонов.
ru.B: Некоторые из глав семей дали пожертвования на работу. Правитель дал в сокровищницу 1000 золотых дариков, пятьдесят чаш и 530 одежд для священников.
ru.R: Некоторые главы семей дали дары на работу. Правитель дал в сокровищницу 1000 золотых монет, которые назывались дариками, пятьдесят чаш и 530 комплектов одежды для священников.

ja.L: そして、父祖のかしらたちのうちのある者たちは、工事のためにささげた。ティルシャタは宝物庫に、金千ダリク、鉢五十、祭司の長衣五百三十[着]を与えた。
ja.B: 一族のかしらたちのうちのある者たちは、工事のためにささげ物をした。総督は宝物庫に、金千ダリク、鉢五十個、祭司の長衣五百三十着を納めた。
ja.R: 家族の指導者たちの中には、工事のためにささげ物をする人たちもいました。総督は、ダリク金貨千枚、鉢五十個、祭司の服五百三十着を、宝物庫にささげました。

uk.L: І деякі з голів батьків дали на роботу. Тіршата дав до скарбниці: золота — 1000 дариків, пʼятдесят чаш, 530 священничих хітонів.
uk.B: Деякі голови родин дали на роботу. Намісник дав до скарбниці 1000 золотих дариків, пʼятдесят чаш і 530 священничих одеж.
uk.R: Деякі голови родів дали дари на роботу. Намісник дав до скарбниці 1000 золотих монет, що звалися дариками, пʼятдесят чаш і 530 одеж для священників.

decisions.choice: from the end of the heads of the fathers: some of the family heads
decisions.reason: "From the end of" means "some of", part of a group (Daniel 1:2). The heads of the fathers are the heads of the families, the leaders of the households listed above.

decisions.choice: darics: Persian gold coins
decisions.reason: The daric was a gold coin of the Persian empire, named after King Darius. The word may also be the Greek drachma; either way it is a coin or weight of gold. These darics are counted, not weighed, so no modern measure is given.

decisions.choice: the work: the work of the house of God; gifts different from Ezra 2:68-69
decisions.reason: In Ezra 2:68-69 the family heads give "for the house of God", to rebuild it. Here the gifts are listed in three parts (verses 69-71), while Ezra gives one total: 61,000 darics, 5,000 minas of silver and 100 priests' garments. The bowls were basins used at the altar, and the tunics were priests' garments (Exodus 28:39-40).

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers (Literal); heads of families (Balanced); family leaders (Readable); the Tirshatha / the governor
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means fathers' houses, the extended families. As in verse 65, Balanced and Readable say "the governor" for the Persian title.

decisions.choice: "dáricos" at every level, as in Ezra 2:69; "tazones" for the bowls
decisions.reason: The daric is a coin, counted, not weighed, so it keeps its name. The bowls are the basins used at the altar.

decisions.choice: « dariques » at every level, as in Ezra 2:69; « bassins » for the bowls
decisions.reason: The daric is a coin, counted, not weighed, so it keeps its name. The bowls are the basins used at the altar.

decisions.choice: "darkoni" at every level, as in Ezra 2:69; "mabakuli" for the bowls
decisions.reason: The daric is a coin, counted, not weighed, so it keeps its name at every level.

decisions.choice: đa-riếc at every level, as in Ezra 2:69; cái chậu for the bowls
decisions.reason: The daric is a coin, counted, not weighed, so it keeps its name at every level.

decisions.choice: "다릭" at every level, as in Ezra 2:69; "대접" for the bowls
decisions.reason: The daric is a coin, counted, not weighed, so it keeps its name at every level.

decisions.choice: os chefes dos pais (L); os chefes das famílias (B, R); dáricos
decisions.reason: As Ezra 2:68-69 in Portuguese: "os chefes das famílias" at Balanced and Readable for the heads of the fathers' houses (m1), Literal keeping "os chefes dos pais", and "dárico" for the Persian gold coin (m2), counted, not weighed, so with no units setting.

decisions.choice: Ezra 2:68-69's words for the gifts: "ዳሪክ" (darics), "ግምጃ ቤት" (treasury), "የካህናት ቀሚሶች" (Literal) / "ልብሶች" (Balanced, Readable); the bowls "መርጫ ሳሕኖች" as the temple's sprinkling bowls in Kings
decisions.reason: Nehemiah 7:69-71 lists the gifts differently from Ezra 2:68-69, so these verses are drafted from Nehemiah's Hebrew with Ezra's vocabulary.

decisions.choice: "पितृकुलों के प्रधान" (L), "परिवारों के प्रधान" (B), "परिवारों के मुखिया" (R); "दारिक"; "कटोरे"; "कुरते" (L), "वस्त्र" (B), "कपड़ों के जोड़े" (R)
decisions.reason: The heads of fathers' houses, the daric and the priests' tunics keep the words of Ezra 2:68-69 at each level; the bowls are कटोरे, as in 1 Kings 7:40. The gifts themselves differ from Ezra's, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "Тиршафа" (L), "правитель" (B, R); "дарики"; "священнические хитоны" (L), "одежды для священников" (B), "комплекты одежды для священников" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Ezra 2:63 and 2:69 in this translation, so that the gifts read as Ezra's do; the daric is a coin, not a measure, and keeps its name at every level, with no units span (the English has none).

decisions.choice: rashei ha'avot "父祖のかしらたち" (L), "一族のかしらたち" (B), "家族の指導者たち" (R); otsar "宝物庫"; darkemonim "ダリク" (R "ダリク金貨"); mizraqot "鉢"; kotnot kohanim "祭司の長衣" (L, B), "祭司の服" (R), as Ezra 2:68-69.
decisions.reason: The Ezra forms for the same gifts; the gifts themselves differ (meaning decision).

source.text: וּמֵֽרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֑וֹת וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And from [the] heads of the fathers they gave to [the] treasury of the work: gold, darics, two ten-thousands; and silver, minas, two thousand and two hundred.

en.L: And some of the heads of the fathers gave to the treasury of the work: gold, 20,000 darics; and silver, 2,200 minas.
en.B: Some of the heads of families gave to the treasury for the work 20,000 gold darics and {{units:about 2,750 pounds of silver|2,200 minas of silver}}.
en.R: Some of the family leaders gave 20,000 gold darics and {{units:about 2,750 pounds of silver|2,200 minas of silver}} to the treasury for the work.

es.L: Y algunos de los jefes de las [casas] paternas dieron al tesoro de la obra: oro, 20 000 dáricos; y plata, 2 200 minas.
es.B: Algunos de los jefes de familia dieron al tesoro para la obra 20 000 dáricos de oro y {{units:unos 1 250 kilos de plata|2 200 minas de plata}}.
es.R: Algunos jefes de familia dieron 20 000 dáricos de oro y {{units:unos 1 250 kilos de plata|2 200 minas de plata}} al tesoro para la obra.

fr.L: Et certains des chefs des pères donnèrent au trésor de l’ouvrage : en or, 20 000 dariques ; et en argent, 2 200 mines.
fr.B: Quelques-uns des chefs des familles donnèrent au trésor de l’ouvrage 20 000 dariques d’or et {{units:environ 1,25 tonne d’argent|2 200 mines d’argent}}.
fr.R: Certains chefs de famille ont donné 20 000 dariques d’or et {{units:environ 1,25 tonne d’argent|2 200 mines d’argent}} au trésor pour les travaux.

sw.L: Na baadhi ya wakuu wa baba walitoa kwa hazina ya kazi: dhahabu, darkoni 20,000; na fedha, mane 2,200.
sw.B: Baadhi ya wakuu wa jamaa walitoa kwa hazina ya kazi darkoni 20,000 za dhahabu na {{units:karibu kilo 1,250 za fedha|mane 2,200 za fedha}}.
sw.R: Baadhi ya viongozi wa jamaa walitoa darkoni 20,000 za dhahabu na {{units:karibu kilo 1,250 za fedha|mane 2,200 za fedha}} kwa hazina kwa ajili ya kazi.

vi.L: Và một số người đứng đầu các gia tộc dâng vào kho cho công việc: vàng, 20.000 đa-riếc; và bạc, 2.200 mi-na.
vi.B: Một số trưởng tộc dâng vào kho cho công việc 20.000 đa-riếc vàng và {{units:khoảng 1,25 tấn bạc|2.200 mi-na bạc}}.
vi.R: Một số người đứng đầu các gia đình dâng 20.000 đa-riếc vàng và {{units:khoảng 1,25 tấn bạc|2.200 mi-na bạc}} vào kho cho công việc.

ko.L: 그리고 조상들의 우두머리들 가운데 몇 사람은 공사의 금고에 금 20,000다릭과 은 2,200마네를 드렸다.
ko.B: 집안 우두머리들 가운데 몇 사람은 공사 기금으로 금 20,000다릭과 은 {{units:약 1.25톤을|2,200마네를}} 바쳤다.
ko.R: 집안 지도자들 가운데 몇 사람은 금 20,000다릭과 은 {{units:약 1.25톤을|2,200마네를}} 공사를 위해 금고에 바쳤다.

pt.L: E alguns dos chefes dos pais deram ao tesouro da obra: ouro, vinte mil dáricos; e prata, 2.200 minas.
pt.B: Alguns dos chefes das famílias deram ao tesouro da obra vinte mil dáricos de ouro e {{units:cerca de 1,3 tonelada de prata|2.200 minas de prata}}.
pt.R: Alguns dos chefes das famílias deram vinte mil dáricos de ouro e {{units:cerca de 1,3 tonelada de prata|2.200 minas de prata}} para o tesouro da obra.

am.L: ከአባቶች [ቤቶች] አለቆችም አንዳንዶቹ ለሥራው ግምጃ ቤት ሰጡ፤ ወርቅ 20,000 ዳሪክ፣ ብርም 2,200 ምናን።

hi.L: और पितृकुलों के प्रधानों में से कुछ ने काम के भंडार में दिया: सोना, 20,000 दारिक; और चाँदी, 2,200 मीना।
hi.B: परिवारों के कुछ प्रधानों ने काम के भंडार में 20,000 सोने के दारिक और {{units:लगभग 1,300 किलो|2,200 मीना}} चाँदी दी।
hi.R: परिवारों के कुछ मुखियों ने काम के लिए भंडार में 20,000 सोने के दारिक और {{units:लगभग 1,300 किलो|2,200 मीना}} चाँदी दी।

ru.L: И некоторые из глав отцовских домов дали в сокровищницу работы: золота — 20 000 дариков, и серебра — 2200 мин.
ru.B: Некоторые из глав семей дали в сокровищницу для работы 20 000 золотых дариков и {{units:около 1,3 тонны|2200 мин}} серебра.
ru.R: Некоторые главы семей дали в сокровищницу на работу 20 000 золотых дариков и {{units:около 1,3 тонны|2200 мин}} серебра.

ja.L: また、父祖のかしらたちのうちのある者たちは、工事のための宝物庫に、金二万ダリクと銀二千二百ミナを与えた。
ja.B: また、一族のかしらたちのうちのある者たちは、工事のための宝物庫に、金二万ダリクと{{units:銀約1.3トン|銀二千二百ミナ}}を納めた。
ja.R: また、家族の指導者たちのうちのある人たちは、ダリク金貨二万枚と{{units:銀約1.3トン|銀二千二百ミナ}}を、工事のための宝物庫にささげました。

uk.B: Деякі голови родин дали до скарбниці на роботу 20 000 золотих дариків і {{units:близько 1250 кілограмів|2200 мін}} срібла.
uk.R: Деякі голови родів дали до скарбниці на роботу 20 000 золотих дариків і {{units:близько 1250 кілограмів|2200 мін}} срібла.

decisions.choice: minas of silver: silver by weight
decisions.reason: A mina was a weight of sixty shekels (Ezekiel 45:12), about 1 1/4 pounds, so 2,200 minas is about 2,750 pounds of silver.

decisions.choice: about 2,750 pounds of silver, with 2,200 minas as the alternative (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the modern weight by default and the original unit as the reader setting; Literal keeps minas.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 1 250 kilos de plata|2 200 minas de plata}} (B, R); Literal keeps "minas"
decisions.reason: As in the English, Balanced and Readable give the weight in metric units by default, with the minas as the reader setting.

decisions.choice: « environ 1,25 tonne d'argent », « 2 200 mines d'argent » as the alternative (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the English, the metric weight is the default and the original unit the reader setting; Literal keeps « mines ».

decisions.choice: "karibu kilo 1,250 za fedha", "mane 2,200 za fedha" as the alternative (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the English, the metric weight is the default and the original unit the reader setting; Literal keeps "mane".

decisions.choice: khoảng 1,25 tấn bạc, 2.200 mi-na bạc as the alternative (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the English, the metric weight is the default and the original unit the reader setting; Literal keeps mi-na.

decisions.choice: "약 1.25톤을", "2,200마네를" as the alternative (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the English, the metric weight is the default and the original unit the reader setting, with the particle inside both options; Literal keeps "마네".

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 1,3 tonelada de prata|2.200 minas de prata}} (B, R); 2.200 minas (L)
alternatives: cerca de 1.250 quilos (the English pounds converted)
decisions.reason: Metric by default with the original unit as the alternative, at 0,6 kg to the mina as the Old Testament terms and Ezra 2:69 have it in Portuguese (2.200 x 0,6 kg = 1.320 kg); "tonelada" stays singular below two, as Portuguese writes it. Literal keeps "minas".

decisions.choice: "{{units:1,320 ኪሎ ያህል|2,200 ምናን}} ብር" at Balanced and Readable; Literal "2,200 ምናን"
decisions.reason: Metric by default, with the mina (0.6 kilo, as the terms list and Ezra 2:69) as the alternative; the English converts to pounds. "ብር" (silver) stays outside the span, since both options take it.

decisions.choice: {{units:लगभग 1,300 किलो|2,200 मीना}} (Balanced, Readable); "2,200 मीना" (Literal)
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 2:69, Balanced and Readable give the weight in kilograms by default, with the minas as the reader setting, where the English gives pounds; the mina is 0.6 kg, as the Pentateuch note sets, rounded as the English rounds. The same in verse 71 (2,000 minas, about 1,200 kg). The figures are below a lakh, so Indian and international grouping agree.

decisions.choice: {{units:около 1,3 тонны|2200 мин}} (B, R); "2200 мин" (L)
decisions.reason: Metric by default, with the original unit as the alternative, as in the English span and as Ezra 2:69 in this translation (a mina 0.6 kg, so 2200 minas about 1.3 tonnes).

decisions.choice: units span "{{units:銀約1.3トン|銀二千二百ミナ}}" (B, R), metric where the English gives pounds; L "銀二千二百ミナ".
decisions.reason: A mina about 0.57 kg, as Ezra 2:69 (五千ミナ 約2.9トン).

decisions.choice: "близько 1250 кілограмів" by default, "2200 мін" as the alternative; in verse 71 "близько 1140 кілограмів" and "2000 мін"
decisions.reason: Metric by default as in the other books, with the mina taken at about 0,57 kg as in Ezra 2:69; Literal keeps the minas, as the English does.

source.text: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֔וֹא וְכֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And what gave [the] rest of the people: gold, darics, two ten-thousand; and silver, minas, two thousand; and tunics of priests, sixty and seven.

en.L: And what the rest of the people gave: gold, 20,000 darics; and silver, 2,000 minas; and sixty-seven priests' tunics.
en.B: What the rest of the people gave was 20,000 gold darics, {{units:about 2,500 pounds of silver|2,000 minas of silver}} and sixty-seven garments for priests.
en.R: The rest of the people gave 20,000 gold darics, {{units:about 2,500 pounds of silver|2,000 minas of silver}} and sixty-seven robes for the priests.

es.L: Y lo que dio el resto del pueblo: oro, 20 000 dáricos; y plata, 2 000 minas; y sesenta y siete túnicas de sacerdotes.
es.B: Lo que dio el resto del pueblo fue 20 000 dáricos de oro, {{units:unos 1 140 kilos de plata|2 000 minas de plata}} y sesenta y siete vestiduras para los sacerdotes.
es.R: El resto del pueblo dio 20 000 dáricos de oro, {{units:unos 1 140 kilos de plata|2 000 minas de plata}} y sesenta y siete túnicas para los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et ce que donna le reste du peuple : en or, 20 000 dariques ; et en argent, 2 000 mines ; et soixante-sept tuniques de prêtres.
fr.B: Ce que donna le reste du peuple fut 20 000 dariques d’or, {{units:environ 1,1 tonne d’argent|2 000 mines d’argent}} et soixante-sept vêtements pour les prêtres.
fr.R: Le reste du peuple a donné 20 000 dariques d’or, {{units:environ 1,1 tonne d’argent|2 000 mines d’argent}} et soixante-sept tuniques pour les prêtres.

sw.L: Na kile walichotoa watu waliobaki: dhahabu, darkoni 20,000; na fedha, mane 2,000; na kanzu za makuhani sitini na saba.
sw.B: Kile walichotoa watu wengine wote kilikuwa darkoni 20,000 za dhahabu, {{units:karibu kilo 1,140 za fedha|mane 2,000 za fedha}} na mavazi sitini na saba ya makuhani.
sw.R: Watu wengine wote walitoa darkoni 20,000 za dhahabu, {{units:karibu kilo 1,140 za fedha|mane 2,000 za fedha}} na kanzu sitini na saba za makuhani.

vi.L: Và những gì phần dân còn lại dâng: vàng, 20.000 đa-riếc; và bạc, 2.000 mi-na; và sáu mươi bảy áo dài của thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Phần dân chúng còn lại dâng 20.000 đa-riếc vàng, {{units:khoảng 1,1 tấn bạc|2.000 mi-na bạc}} và sáu mươi bảy bộ áo cho các thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Những người dân còn lại dâng 20.000 đa-riếc vàng, {{units:khoảng 1,1 tấn bạc|2.000 mi-na bạc}} và sáu mươi bảy bộ áo cho các thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 그리고 나머지 백성이 드린 것은 금 20,000다릭과 은 2,000마네와 제사장의 옷 67벌이었다.
ko.B: 나머지 백성이 바친 것은 금 20,000다릭과 은 {{units:약 1.1톤과|2,000마네와}} 제사장의 옷 67벌이었다.
ko.R: 나머지 백성은 금 20,000다릭과 은 {{units:약 1.1톤과|2,000마네와}} 제사장들이 입을 옷 67벌을 바쳤다.

pt.L: E o que o resto do povo deu: ouro, vinte mil dáricos; e prata, duas mil minas; e sessenta e sete túnicas de sacerdotes.
pt.B: O que o resto do povo deu foi vinte mil dáricos de ouro, {{units:cerca de 1,2 tonelada de prata|duas mil minas de prata}} e sessenta e sete túnicas para os sacerdotes.
pt.R: O resto do povo deu vinte mil dáricos de ouro, {{units:cerca de 1,2 tonelada de prata|duas mil minas de prata}} e sessenta e sete túnicas para os sacerdotes.

am.L: የቀረውም ሕዝብ የሰጠው፤ ወርቅ 20,000 ዳሪክ፣ ብርም 2,000 ምናን፣ የካህናትም ቀሚሶች ስልሳ ሰባት።
am.B: የቀረው ሕዝብ የሰጠው 20,000 የወርቅ ዳሪክ፣ {{units:1,200 ኪሎ ያህል|2,000 ምናን}} ብርና ለካህናት ስልሳ ሰባት ልብሶች ነበረ።
am.R: የቀረው ሕዝብ 20,000 የወርቅ ዳሪክ፣ {{units:1,200 ኪሎ ያህል|2,000 ምናን}} ብርና ለካህናቱ ስልሳ ሰባት ልብሶች ሰጠ።

hi.L: और जो बाक़ी लोगों ने दिया: सोना, 20,000 दारिक; और चाँदी, 2,000 मीना; और याजकों के सड़सठ कुरते।
hi.B: बाक़ी लोगों ने जो दिया, वह 20,000 सोने के दारिक, {{units:लगभग 1,200 किलो|2,000 मीना}} चाँदी और याजकों के लिए सड़सठ वस्त्र थे।
hi.R: बाक़ी लोगों ने 20,000 सोने के दारिक, {{units:लगभग 1,200 किलो|2,000 मीना}} चाँदी और याजकों के लिए कपड़ों के सड़सठ जोड़े दिए।

ru.L: И то, что дал остальной народ: золота — 20 000 дариков, и серебра — 2000 мин, и шестьдесят семь священнических хитонов.
ru.B: Остальной народ дал 20 000 золотых дариков, {{units:около 1,2 тонны|2000 мин}} серебра и шестьдесят семь одежд для священников.
ru.R: Остальные люди дали 20 000 золотых дариков, {{units:около 1,2 тонны|2000 мин}} серебра и шестьдесят семь комплектов одежды для священников.

ja.L: そして、そのほかの民が与えたものは、金二万ダリク、銀二千ミナ、祭司の長衣六十七[着]であった。
ja.B: そのほかの民が納めたものは、金二万ダリク、{{units:銀約1.1トン|銀二千ミナ}}、祭司の長衣六十七着であった。
ja.R: そのほかの人々は、ダリク金貨二万枚、{{units:銀約1.1トン|銀二千ミナ}}、祭司の服六十七着をささげました。

uk.L: А що дала решта народу: золота — 20 000 дариків, і срібла — 2000 мін, і шістдесят сім священничих хітонів.
uk.B: Решта народу дала 20 000 золотих дариків, {{units:близько 1140 кілограмів|2000 мін}} срібла і шістдесят сім священничих одеж.
uk.R: Решта народу дала 20 000 золотих дариків, {{units:близько 1140 кілограмів|2000 мін}} срібла і шістдесят сім одеж для священників.

decisions.choice: the rest of the people: the gifts of everyone else; the totals of verses 69-71
decisions.reason: With the governor's gift and the family heads' gifts, the total comes to 41,000 darics, 4,200 minas of silver, fifty bowls and 597 priests' garments.

decisions.choice: about 2,500 pounds of silver, with 2,000 minas as the alternative (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 70, the modern weight is the default and the original unit the reader setting; Literal keeps minas.

decisions.choice: "{{units:1,200 ኪሎ ያህል|2,000 ምናን}} ብር" at Balanced and Readable; Literal "2,000 ምናን"
decisions.reason: As verse 70.

decisions.choice: {{units:около 1,2 тонны|2000 мин}} (B, R); "2000 мин" (L)
decisions.reason: As in verse 70: a mina 0.6 kg, so 2000 minas about 1.2 tonnes, with the minas as the alternative.

source.text: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֡ם וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּמִן־הָעָ֧ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֛ים וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And dwelt the priests and the Levites and the gatekeepers and the singers and some of the people and the Nethinim and all Israel in their cities. And arrived the month the seventh, and [the] sons of Israel [were] in their cities.

en.L: And the priests and the Levites and the gatekeepers and the singers and some of the people and the Nethinim and all Israel lived in their cities. And the seventh month came, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel [were] in their cities.
en.B: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants and all Israel settled in their towns. When the seventh month came, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} were in their towns.
en.R: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, some of the other people and all the rest of Israel settled in their own towns. When the seventh month came, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} were living in their towns.

es.L: Y los sacerdotes y los levitas y los porteros y los cantores y [algunos] del pueblo y los netineos y todo Israel habitaron en sus ciudades. Y llegó el mes séptimo, y los hijos de Israel [estaban] en sus ciudades.
es.B: Así, los sacerdotes, los levitas, los porteros, los cantores, parte del pueblo, los servidores del templo y todo Israel se establecieron en sus ciudades. Cuando llegó el mes séptimo, los israelitas estaban en sus ciudades.
es.R: Así, los sacerdotes, los levitas, los porteros, los cantores, los servidores del templo, una parte del pueblo y todo el resto de Israel se establecieron en sus propias ciudades. Cuando llegó el mes séptimo, los israelitas ya vivían en sus ciudades.

fr.L: Et les prêtres et les Lévites et les portiers et les chanteurs et une partie du peuple et les Nethinim et tout Israël habitèrent dans leurs villes. Et le septième mois arriva, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël [étaient] dans leurs villes.
fr.B: Ainsi les prêtres, les Lévites, les portiers, les chanteurs, une partie du peuple, les serviteurs du temple et tout Israël s’établirent dans leurs villes. Quand le septième mois arriva, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} étaient dans leurs villes.
fr.R: Ainsi les prêtres, les Lévites, les portiers, les chanteurs, les serviteurs du temple, une partie des autres gens et tout le reste d’Israël se sont installés dans leurs villes. Quand le septième mois est arrivé, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} habitaient dans leurs villes.

sw.L: Na makuhani na Walawi na mabawabu na waimbaji na baadhi ya watu na Wanethinimu na Israeli wote wakakaa katika miji yao. Na mwezi wa saba ulipofika, nao wana wa Israeli [walikuwa] katika miji yao.
sw.B: Hivyo makuhani, Walawi, mabawabu, waimbaji, baadhi ya watu, watumishi wa hekalu na Israeli wote walikaa katika miji yao. Mwezi wa saba ulipofika, Waisraeli walikuwa katika miji yao.
sw.R: Hivyo makuhani, Walawi, walinzi wa malango, waimbaji, watumishi wa hekalu, baadhi ya watu wengine na Waisraeli wengine wote walikaa katika miji yao wenyewe. Mwezi wa saba ulipofika, Waisraeli walikuwa wakiishi katika miji yao.

vi.L: Và các thầy tế lễ, người Lê-vi, những người giữ cổng, những người ca hát, một số dân chúng, người Nê-thi-nim và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên ở trong các thành của họ. Và tháng thứ bảy đến, và con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên [đã ở] trong các thành của họ.
vi.B: Vậy các thầy tế lễ, người Lê-vi, những người giữ cổng, những người ca hát, một số dân chúng, những người phục dịch đền thờ và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên định cư trong các thành của mình. Khi tháng thứ bảy đến, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã ở trong các thành của mình.
vi.R: Vậy các thầy tế lễ, người Lê-vi, những người giữ cổng, những người ca hát, những người phục dịch đền thờ, một số dân chúng khác và tất cả những người Y-sơ-ra-ên còn lại định cư trong các thành của mình. Khi tháng thứ bảy đến, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đang sống trong các thành của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 문지기들과 노래하는 자들과 백성 가운데 일부와 느디님 사람들과 온 이스라엘이 자기 성읍들에 살았다. 그리고 일곱째 달이 되었고, 이스라엘 자손은 자기 성읍들에 [있었다].
ko.B: 이렇게 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 문지기들과 노래하는 사람들과 백성 가운데 일부와 성전 봉사자들과 온 이스라엘이 자기 성읍에 자리 잡았다. 일곱째 달이 되었을 때, 이스라엘 자손은 자기 성읍에 있었다.
ko.R: 이렇게 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 문지기들과 노래하는 사람들과 성전에서 일을 돕는 사람들과 다른 백성 가운데 일부와 나머지 온 이스라엘이 자기 성읍에 자리를 잡고 살았다. 일곱째 달이 되었을 때, 이스라엘 자손은 자기 성읍에서 살고 있었다.

pt.L: E os sacerdotes e os levitas e os porteiros e os cantores e alguns do povo e os servidores do templo e todo Israel habitaram nas suas cidades. E chegou o sétimo mês, e os filhos de Israel [estavam] nas suas cidades.
pt.B: Assim os sacerdotes, os levitas, os porteiros, os cantores, alguns do povo, os servidores do templo e todo Israel moraram nas suas cidades. Quando chegou o sétimo mês, os israelitas estavam nas suas cidades.
pt.R: Assim os sacerdotes, os levitas, os porteiros, os cantores, os servidores do templo, algumas pessoas do povo e todo o resto de Israel se estabeleceram nas suas próprias cidades. Quando chegou o sétimo mês, os israelitas estavam morando nas suas cidades.

am.L: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ፣ በር ጠባቂዎቹና መዘምራኑ፣ ከሕዝቡም አንዳንዶቹ ናታኒምም እስራኤልም ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ። ሰባተኛውም ወር ደረሰ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከተሞቻቸው [ነበሩ]።
am.B: ስለዚህ ካህናቱ፣ ሌዋውያኑ፣ በር ጠባቂዎቹ፣ መዘምራኑ፣ ከሕዝቡ አንዳንዶቹ፣ የቤተ መቅደሱ አገልጋዮችና እስራኤል ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ። ሰባተኛው ወር በደረሰ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች በከተሞቻቸው ነበሩ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ካህናቱ፣ ሌዋውያኑ፣ በር ጠባቂዎቹ፣ መዘምራኑ፣ የቤተ መቅደሱ አገልጋዮች፣ ከሕዝቡ አንዳንዶቹና የቀሩት እስራኤላውያን ሁሉ በገዛ ከተሞቻቸው ሰፈሩ። ሰባተኛው ወር በደረሰ ጊዜ እስራኤላውያን በከተሞቻቸው ይኖሩ ነበር።

hi.L: और याजक और लेवी और द्वारपाल और गायक और लोगों में से कुछ और मन्दिर के सेवक और सारा इस्राएल अपने नगरों में रहने लगे। और सातवाँ महीना आया, और {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्र}} अपने नगरों में [थे]।
hi.B: तब याजक, लेवी, द्वारपाल, गायक, लोगों में से कुछ, मन्दिर के सेवक और सारा इस्राएल अपने नगरों में बस गए। जब सातवाँ महीना आया, तब इस्राएली अपने नगरों में थे।
hi.R: तब याजक, लेवी, द्वारपाल, गायक, मन्दिर के सेवक, कुछ दूसरे लोग और बाक़ी सारा इस्राएल अपने-अपने नगरों में बस गए। जब सातवाँ महीना आया, तब इस्राएली अपने नगरों में रह रहे थे।

ru.L: И поселились священники, и левиты, и привратники, и певцы, и [некоторые] из народа, и храмовые служители, и весь Израиль в своих городах. И настал седьмой месяц, и {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}} [были] в своих городах.
ru.B: Так священники, левиты, привратники, певцы, часть народа, храмовые служители и весь Израиль поселились в своих городах. Когда настал седьмой месяц, израильтяне были в своих городах.
ru.R: Так священники, левиты, привратники, певцы, служители храма, часть народа и весь остальной Израиль поселились в своих городах. Когда настал седьмой месяц, израильтяне жили в своих городах.

ja.L: こうして、祭司たち、レビ人たち、門衛たち、歌い手たち、民のある者たち、神殿に仕える者たち、全イスラエルは、自分たちの町々に住んだ。そして第七の月が来たとき、イスラエルの子らは自分たちの町々にいた。
ja.B: こうして、祭司、レビ人、門衛、歌い手、民の一部、神殿の奉仕者たち、そして全イスラエルは、それぞれ自分の町に住んだ。第七の月が来たとき、イスラエルの人々は自分たちの町にいた。
ja.R: こうして、祭司、レビ人、門番、歌い手、神殿で働く人たち、ほかの民の一部、そしてほかのイスラエルの人々も皆、それぞれ自分の町に住みつきました。第七の月になったとき、イスラエルの人々は、それぞれ自分の町に住んでいました。

uk.L: І оселилися священники, і левити, і воротарі, і співаки, і частина народу, і нетиніми, і весь Ізраїль у своїх містах. І настав сьомий місяць, і {{gender:нащадки Ізраїля|сини Ізраїля}} [були] у своїх містах.
uk.B: Тож священники, левити, воротарі, співаки, частина народу, храмові слуги і весь Ізраїль оселилися у своїх містах. Коли настав сьомий місяць, ізраїльтяни були у своїх містах.
uk.R: Тож священники, левити, воротарі, співаки, храмові слуги, частина іншого народу і весь інший Ізраїль оселилися у своїх містах. Коли настав сьомий місяць, ізраїльтяни вже жили у своїх містах.

decisions.choice: settled in their towns: the end of the register, as in Ezra 2:70
decisions.reason: The register ends by saying that each group settled in its own towns. "Some of the people" probably means those who settled in and near Jerusalem, set beside the rest of Israel in the other towns.

decisions.choice: the seventh month came: the words that lead into the great gathering of chapter 8
decisions.reason: The seventh month (in early autumn) held the Day of Trumpets, the Day of Atonement and the Feast of Booths (Leviticus 23:23-43). The same words in Ezra 3:1 introduce the rebuilding of the altar; here they lead into the reading of the law in Nehemiah's own day (8:1-2). Many Bibles start a new paragraph or section with these words. In many Bibles this verse is numbered 7:73 (see verse 68).

decisions.choice: the Israelites, with sons of Israel as the alternative (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Sons of Israel" means the whole people, men and women, so the inclusive form is the default and the traditional wording the alternative. Literal has "children" with "sons" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Israeli" (L), "Waisraeli" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Ezra 3:1, the same words.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms and Nehemiah 1:6 in Portuguese: "filhos" and "israelitas" already include women and men, so Portuguese has no second wording to offer where the English has a gender span. The rest of the verse keeps the Portuguese of Ezra 2:70.

decisions.choice: The groups in Nehemiah's order (gatekeepers before singers, "all Israel" in the one list), with Ezra 2:70's words; "ሰባተኛውም ወር ደረሰ" as Ezra 3:1
decisions.reason: Nehemiah's Hebrew orders the groups differently from Ezra 2:70 and joins the end of the list to the coming of the seventh month, as Ezra 3:1 does.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (Literal, Balanced), "እስራኤላውያን" (Readable), as Ezra 3:1
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" already includes daughters, so Amharic has no second wording to offer where the English has "children / Israelites" beside "sons".

decisions.choice: {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्र}} (L); "इस्राएली" (B, R), no span
decisions.reason: The sons of Israel in the forms of the Pentateuch note, as in Ezra 3:1: the gender span at Literal; Balanced and Readable say इस्राएली, which already includes everyone, so the English span there has no Hindi counterpart. The first sentence follows Ezra 2:70 in Nehemiah's order.

decisions.choice: the order of Nehemiah's Hebrew (gatekeepers before singers, all Israel in the same clause), in the words of Ezra 2:70
decisions.reason: Ezra 2:70 lists the singers before the gatekeepers and ends "и весь Израиль — в своих городах"; Nehemiah's Hebrew lists the gatekeepers first and names all Israel in one clause, then adds the seventh month.

decisions.choice: {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}} (L); "израильтяне" with no span (B, R)
alternatives: a gender span at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As in Nehemiah 8:17 in this translation: "израильтяне" already takes in men and women, so the English Israelites/sons of Israel span has no Russian counterpart at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "イスラエルの子ら" (L), "イスラエルの人々" (B, R) are already inclusive; "the seventh month" "第七の月" every level.
decisions.reason: The Japanese has nothing for the setting to change; month as 2 Chronicles 29:3.
